annotations.title: Open a GmbH or UG in Germany: steps and fees

description: Gives the steps to open a German GmbH or UG (haftungsbeschränkt) from the number of founders and the share capital. Returns the legal form the capital allows (GmbH from 25,000 €, otherwise UG), whether the statutory Musterprotokoll fits (up to 3 founders, one managing director, no clauses of their own), the minimum deposit before the register application, the notary and commercial register fees as an estimated range (the notary's invoice under the GNotKG decides), the steps that follow, what Norman does next (checks the company name, writes the founding documents and lists notaries in the city, including ones that notarise by video, with their contact details), and continueInNorman, a link that opens Norman's chat for starting the company with this plan filled in. Rules only: no account access, nothing is saved, and the result is general information, not legal or tax advice. The inputs hold no personal data: companyName is the planned company's name, and there are no fields for founders' names, birth dates, addresses or email.

businessPurpose.description: Unternehmensgegenstand: one concrete sentence on what the company does.

companyName.description: Planned name of the company, not a person's name.

founders.description: Number of founders (shareholders); Norman supports up to 5.

idea.description: The user's business idea in their own words.

individualArticles.description: True when the founders want articles of their own instead of the statutory template.

managingDirectors.description: Number of managing directors; defaults to 1.

year.description: Year of the rules and rates: 2026.
